column1: presentation|n.|展示；报告|give a presentation|She gave a presentation on climate change.|她做了一场关于气候变化的报告。|His presentation helped the team understand the new design.|他的展示帮助团队理解了新设计。
anxious|adj.|焦虑的；担忧的|feel anxious about|I felt anxious about speaking in public.|我对当众讲话感到焦虑。|She was anxious about her missing cat.|她为走失的猫感到担忧。
outline|n.|提纲|a brief outline|Write a brief outline before you begin.|开始之前写一份简短提纲。|The editor asked for an outline of the novel.|编辑索要了这部小说的提纲。
rehearsal|n.|排练|a final rehearsal|We held a final rehearsal before the show.|演出前我们进行了最后一次排练。|The musicians arrived early for rehearsal.|乐手们早早到场排练。
practical|adj.|实用的|practical advice|Her practical advice made the task easier.|她的实用建议让任务变得更容易。|This small bag is practical for daily shopping.|这个小包适合日常购物，很实用。
confidence|n.|信心|gain confidence|Regular practice helped him gain confidence.|规律练习帮助他树立了信心。|Learning to swim gave her new confidence.|学会游泳给了她新的信心。
audience|n.|观众；听众|a large audience|The speaker welcomed the audience.|演讲者欢迎了在场听众。|The audience laughed at the actor's joke.|观众被演员的笑话逗笑了。
approach|n.|方法|a new approach to|We need a new approach to this problem.|我们需要一种解决这个问题的新方法。|Her approach to teaching makes difficult ideas clear.|她的教学方法让复杂概念变得清晰。
focus|v.|集中注意力|focus on|Try to focus on your main argument.|试着集中精力阐述你的主要论点。|I cannot focus on reading in this noisy room.|在这个嘈杂的房间里，我无法专心阅读。
clarify|v.|澄清；讲清楚|clarify a point|Could you clarify your last point?|你能讲清楚刚才的最后一点吗？|The new sign will clarify where visitors should wait.|新标识将明确访客应该在哪里等候。
research|n.|研究|conduct research|The students conducted research on sleep.|学生们开展了关于睡眠的研究。|Her research explores how birds find their way home.|她的研究探讨鸟类如何找到回家的路。
evidence|n.|证据|strong evidence|There is strong evidence to support the claim.|有充分证据支持这一说法。|The broken window was evidence of a burglary.|破碎的窗户是入室盗窃的证据。
survey|n.|调查|carry out a survey|We carried out a survey of local students.|我们对当地学生进行了一项调查。|A customer survey revealed a demand for longer opening hours.|一项顾客调查显示人们希望延长营业时间。
analysis|n.|分析|detailed analysis|The report includes a detailed analysis of the results.|报告包含对结果的详细分析。|Her analysis of the poem revealed its quiet humor.|她对这首诗的分析揭示了其中含蓄的幽默。
reliable|adj.|可靠的|a reliable source|Choose a reliable source for your facts.|为事实信息选择可靠的来源。|We need a reliable car for the long trip.|长途旅行需要一辆可靠的车。
conclude|v.|得出结论|conclude that|We can conclude that the plan is effective.|我们可以得出结论，这个计划有效。|The doctor could not conclude that the treatment had worked.|医生无法断定治疗已经奏效。
method|n.|方法|a useful method|This is a useful method for taking notes.|这是一种实用的记笔记方法。|The chef showed us a simple method for making bread.|厨师教了我们一种简单的面包制作方法。
relevant|adj.|相关的|relevant to|Keep only information relevant to the topic.|只保留与主题相关的信息。|Do you have any experience relevant to this job?|你有与这份工作相关的经验吗？
source|n.|来源|a source of information|Always record the source of your information.|一定要记录信息来源。|The sun is our main source of energy.|太阳是我们主要的能量来源。
accurate|adj.|准确的|accurate information|Check that the information is accurate.|核对信息是否准确。|The map gives an accurate picture of the coastline.|这张地图准确描绘了海岸线。
journey|n.|旅程|a long journey|The long journey began before sunrise.|漫长的旅程在日出前开始。|Her daily journey to work takes an hour.|她每天的上班路程需要一小时。
destination|n.|目的地|reach a destination|We reached our destination before dark.|天黑前我们到达了目的地。|Paris was the final destination on their tour.|巴黎是他们旅途的最后一站。
accommodation|n.|住宿|book accommodation|We booked accommodation near the station.|我们预订了车站附近的住宿。|The university provides accommodation for new students.|大学为新生提供住宿。
reservation|n.|预订|make a reservation|I made a reservation for two nights.|我预订了两晚住宿。|Do you have a reservation for dinner?|你预订晚餐位了吗？
departure|n.|出发|departure time|Please check the departure time carefully.|请仔细核对出发时间。|We waved goodbye before her departure.|她出发前，我们挥手告别。
luggage|n.|行李|heavy luggage|He helped me carry my heavy luggage.|他帮我搬运沉重的行李。|Passengers must keep their luggage with them.|乘客必须随身看管行李。
delay|n.|延误|a short delay|There was a short delay at the airport.|机场出现了短暂延误。|A technical fault caused a delay in the broadcast.|技术故障导致了播出延误。
alternative|adj.|可供选择的；替代的|an alternative plan|We discussed an alternative plan.|我们讨论了一个备选计划。|The doctor suggested an alternative treatment.|医生建议采用另一种治疗方案。
route|n.|路线|plan a route|We planned a route through the mountains.|我们规划了一条穿越山区的路线。|This bus route connects the hospital and the library.|这条公交线路连接医院和图书馆。
arrival|n.|到达|on arrival|Please call me on arrival.|到达后请给我打电话。|The children waited for their grandmother's arrival.|孩子们等待着奶奶到来。
project|n.|项目|a group project|Our group project explores local history.|我们的小组项目研究当地历史。|The bridge project will take two years.|这项桥梁工程需要两年时间。
deadline|n.|截止期限|meet a deadline|We worked hard to meet the deadline.|我们努力工作以赶上截止期限。|The application deadline is next Friday.|申请截止日期是下周五。
assign|v.|分配|assign a task|The leader will assign a task to each member.|负责人将给每位成员分配任务。|The teacher will assign seats on Monday.|老师将在周一分配座位。
cooperate|v.|合作|cooperate with|We must cooperate with the other team.|我们必须与另一支团队合作。|The two countries agreed to cooperate on science.|两国同意在科学领域开展合作。
responsibility|n.|责任|take responsibility for|Each member takes responsibility for one section.|每位成员负责一个部分。|Caring for the garden is my responsibility.|照料花园是我的责任。
efficient|adj.|高效的|an efficient system|An efficient system saves everyone time.|高效的系统为所有人节省时间。|The new engine is more efficient than the old one.|新发动机比旧的更高效。
priority|n.|优先事项|a top priority|Safety is our top priority.|安全是我们的首要任务。|Finding clean water became their main priority.|找到干净的水成了他们最优先的事项。
progress|n.|进展|make progress|We are making steady progress on the report.|我们的报告正稳步推进。|She made great progress in learning the piano.|她在学习钢琴方面取得了很大进步。
obstacle|n.|障碍|overcome an obstacle|A lack of time was our biggest obstacle.|时间不足是我们最大的障碍。|The fallen tree was an obstacle on the road.|倒下的树是路上的障碍物。
accomplish|v.|完成|accomplish a goal|Together we can accomplish this goal.|我们一起可以完成这个目标。|She hopes to accomplish a great deal this summer.|她希望今年夏天能完成许多事情。
environment|n.|环境|protect the environment|Everyone can help protect the environment.|每个人都能为保护环境出力。|Plants grow well in a warm environment.|植物在温暖的环境中生长良好。
resource|n.|资源|a valuable resource|Clean water is a valuable resource.|洁净的水是一种宝贵资源。|The library is a useful resource for students.|图书馆是学生可利用的一项有用资源。
conserve|v.|节约；保护|conserve water|Turn off the tap to conserve water.|关掉水龙头以节约用水。|The building is designed to conserve heat.|这座建筑的设计可以保存热量。
pollution|n.|污染|air pollution|Heavy traffic causes air pollution.|繁忙的交通造成空气污染。|The factory reduced pollution in the river.|工厂减少了对河流的污染。
sustain|v.|维持|sustain growth|We need enough funding to sustain the project.|我们需要足够资金来维持这个项目。|Good soil helps sustain plant growth.|良好的土壤有助于维持植物生长。
consume|v.|消耗|consume energy|Old machines consume a lot of energy.|旧机器消耗大量能源。|This task will consume most of our time.|这个任务将耗费我们大部分时间。
recycle|v.|回收利用|recycle paper|Our school encourages us to recycle paper.|学校鼓励我们回收废纸。|The company can recycle old mobile phones.|这家公司可以回收利用旧手机。
impact|n.|影响|have an impact on|Small changes can have a big impact on waste.|小改变能够对废物数量产生很大影响。|The new law had a major impact on local businesses.|新法律对当地企业产生了重大影响。
reduce|v.|减少|reduce waste|Bring your own cup to reduce waste.|自带杯子以减少浪费。|Daily exercise can reduce stress.|每天锻炼可以减轻压力。
protect|v.|保护|protect from|Trees help protect the soil from the wind.|树木有助于保护土壤免受风蚀。|Wear a hat to protect your skin from the sun.|戴帽子保护皮肤免受日晒。
career|n.|职业生涯|a career in|She wants a career in education.|她想从事教育事业。|His career as a musician lasted forty years.|他的音乐家生涯持续了四十年。
interview|n.|面试|a job interview|I have a job interview on Monday.|我周一有一场求职面试。|The scholarship interview lasted twenty minutes.|奖学金面试持续了二十分钟。
certificate|n.|证书|a training certificate|Bring your training certificate to the interview.|带上培训证书去参加面试。|Each swimmer received a certificate after the course.|课程结束后，每位游泳学员都获得了一张证书。
experience|n.|经验|work experience|She has three years of work experience.|她有三年工作经验。|You do not need any experience to join the class.|参加这门课不需要任何经验。
candidate|n.|候选人|a suitable candidate|We are looking for a suitable candidate.|我们正在寻找合适的候选人。|Each candidate explained their plans for the club.|每位候选人都说明了对俱乐部的规划。
opportunity|n.|机会|an opportunity to|This is an opportunity to learn new skills.|这是学习新技能的机会。|Travel offers an opportunity to meet new people.|旅行提供了结识新朋友的机会。
negotiate|v.|协商|negotiate with|She will negotiate with the manager about pay.|她将与经理商谈薪酬。|The neighbors agreed to negotiate over the boundary.|邻居们同意就边界问题进行协商。
salary|n.|薪水|an annual salary|The annual salary is listed in the advertisement.|广告中列出了年薪。|His salary increased after the promotion.|升职后，他的薪水增加了。
ambition|n.|志向；抱负|achieve an ambition|Her ambition is to become an engineer.|她的志向是成为一名工程师。|Winning a national race was his greatest ambition.|赢得全国性比赛是他最大的抱负。
profession|n.|职业|the medical profession|He decided to enter the medical profession.|他决定从事医疗行业。|Teaching is a demanding profession.|教师是一份要求很高的职业。
experiment|n.|实验|conduct an experiment|We conducted an experiment with seeds.|我们用种子进行了一项实验。|The experiment tested a new type of battery.|这项实验测试了一种新型电池。
hypothesis|n.|假设|test a hypothesis|The experiment will test our hypothesis.|这个实验将检验我们的假设。|Her hypothesis was that light changes sleep patterns.|她的假设是光线会改变睡眠模式。
observe|v.|观察|observe carefully|Observe the plants carefully each day.|每天仔细观察这些植物。|We watched quietly to observe the birds' behavior.|我们安静地观看，以观察鸟类行为。
measure|v.|测量|measure the length|Use a ruler to measure the length.|用尺子测量长度。|The nurse will measure your temperature.|护士将测量你的体温。
variable|n.|变量|a key variable|Temperature is a key variable in this experiment.|温度是这个实验中的关键变量。|Income is one variable in the study of spending.|收入是消费研究中的一个变量。
precise|adj.|精确的|precise measurements|We need precise measurements for the model.|制作模型需要精确的测量数据。|The guide gave us precise directions to the house.|向导给了我们前往那所房子的确切路线说明。
sample|n.|样本|a small sample|We collected a small sample of water.|我们采集了一小份水样。|The shop offered a sample of its new tea.|商店提供了一份新茶的试饮样品。
consistent|adj.|一致的|consistent results|Repeated tests produced consistent results.|重复测试得出了一致的结果。|Her story was consistent with the recorded evidence.|她的说法与记录的证据一致。
interpret|v.|解释；理解|interpret the results|We must interpret the results carefully.|我们必须谨慎解释这些结果。|Readers may interpret the poem in different ways.|读者可能以不同方式理解这首诗。
demonstrate|v.|证明；表明|demonstrate that|The results demonstrate that the method works.|结果表明这个方法有效。|This example will demonstrate why the rule matters.|这个例子将说明这条规则为什么重要。
community|n.|社区|a local community|The local community helped build the garden.|当地社区协助建设了花园。|The library serves the whole community.|图书馆为整个社区服务。
volunteer|n.|志愿者|a volunteer group|A volunteer showed us where to go.|一位志愿者给我们指了路。|The hospital needs a volunteer to welcome visitors.|医院需要一名志愿者接待访客。
contribute|v.|贡献|contribute to|Everyone can contribute to the project.|每个人都能为这个项目贡献力量。|She will contribute an article to the magazine.|她将为这本杂志撰稿。
charity|n.|慈善机构|a local charity|The money will go to a local charity.|这笔钱将捐给当地一家慈善机构。|The charity provides meals for older people.|这家慈善机构为老年人提供餐食。
participate|v.|参加|participate in|All students can participate in the event.|所有学生都可以参加这次活动。|Ten schools will participate in the debate.|十所学校将参加辩论赛。
organize|v.|组织|organize an event|We plan to organize a weekend sale.|我们计划组织一场周末义卖。|She helped organize a welcome party for the visitors.|她帮助为访客组织了一场欢迎聚会。
support|n.|支持|provide support|The project received support from local shops.|这个项目得到了当地商店的支持。|His family gave him support during the difficult year.|在艰难的一年里，他的家人给予了支持。
concern|n.|关切；担忧|show concern for|They showed concern for older residents.|他们表达了对年长居民的关切。|Her main concern was the children's safety.|她最关心的是孩子们的安全。
benefit|n.|益处|a lasting benefit|The garden brings a lasting benefit to the area.|这座花园给这个地区带来长久的益处。|One benefit of walking is better sleep.|步行的一项益处是改善睡眠。
individual|n.|个人|each individual|Each individual has something to offer.|每个人都有可以贡献的东西。|The course is designed to help each individual learn.|这门课程旨在帮助每个人学习。
technology|n.|技术|modern technology|Modern technology connects people across the world.|现代技术把世界各地的人联系起来。|New technology allows doctors to see inside the body.|新技术让医生能观察人体内部。
device|n.|设备|an electronic device|This device can measure your heart rate.|这台设备可以测量心率。|Please turn off every electronic device before the test.|测试前请关闭所有电子设备。
access|n.|使用权；获取途径|access to|Students have access to the online library.|学生有权使用在线图书馆。|The village now has access to clean water.|这个村庄现在能够获得洁净用水。
secure|adj.|安全的|a secure connection|Use a secure connection when sending personal data.|发送个人数据时要使用安全连接。|The documents are in a secure cabinet.|文件存放在一个安全的柜子里。
privacy|n.|隐私|protect privacy|The service is designed to protect your privacy.|这项服务旨在保护你的隐私。|Everyone deserves some privacy at home.|每个人在家都应该拥有一些隐私。
innovation|n.|创新|technical innovation|Innovation can make everyday tasks easier.|创新能让日常任务变得更轻松。|This simple innovation reduced food waste.|这一简单的创新减少了食物浪费。
digital|adj.|数字的|a digital record|Keep a digital record of your notes.|保留一份笔记的数字记录。|The museum has created a digital collection of paintings.|博物馆建立了绘画作品的数字馆藏。
network|n.|网络|a computer network|The computer network connects all the classrooms.|计算机网络连接了所有教室。|The city has an extensive network of cycle paths.|这座城市拥有广泛的自行车道网络。
transfer|v.|转移；传输|transfer data|You can transfer data between the two devices.|你可以在两台设备之间传输数据。|We need to transfer the plants to larger pots.|我们需要把植物移到更大的花盆里。
convenient|adj.|方便的|a convenient way|Online booking is a convenient way to buy tickets.|在线预订是购票的便捷方式。|The shop is in a convenient location near the station.|商店位于车站附近，位置便利。
challenge|n.|挑战|face a challenge|Learning a new language is an exciting challenge.|学习新语言是一项令人兴奋的挑战。|The steep climb was the hardest challenge of the trip.|陡峭的攀登是旅途中最艰巨的挑战。
adapt|v.|适应|adapt to|It takes time to adapt to a new routine.|适应新的日常安排需要时间。|Some animals adapt well to city life.|一些动物能很好地适应城市生活。
persist|v.|坚持|persist in|She chose to persist in her efforts.|她选择坚持努力。|If you persist in practicing, your drawing will improve.|如果坚持练习，你的绘画水平就会提高。
strategy|n.|策略|a learning strategy|Choose a learning strategy that suits you.|选择适合自己的学习策略。|The team changed its strategy after losing the first game.|输掉第一场比赛后，团队改变了策略。
motive|n.|动机|a strong motive|Curiosity was her main motive for studying science.|好奇心是她学习科学的主要动机。|The police could not establish a motive for the theft.|警方无法确定盗窃行为的动机。
discipline|n.|自律|self-discipline|Daily practice requires discipline.|每天练习需要自律。|Saving money takes patience and discipline.|攒钱需要耐心和自律。
achieve|v.|实现|achieve a goal|Small steps help you achieve your goals.|小步前进能帮助你实现目标。|She worked hard to achieve her dream of flying.|她努力实现自己的飞行梦想。
improve|v.|改善；提高|improve steadily|Your writing will improve with practice.|你的写作会随着练习而提高。|The new windows will improve the lighting in the room.|新窗户将改善房间的采光。
reflect|v.|认真思考；反思|reflect on|Take time to reflect on what you have learned.|花点时间反思你学到的东西。|The coach asked the players to reflect on the match.|教练让队员们反思这场比赛。
maintain|v.|保持；维持|maintain a habit|It is easier to maintain a habit with a clear plan.|有明确计划，更容易保持一个习惯。|The workers maintain the road throughout the year.|工人们全年维护这条道路。
